1. Allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The Application stands disposed of.
MAC.APP. 285/2025 & CM APPL. 27029/2025 [Stay]

3. The present Appeal has been filed on behalf of the Appellant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 impugning the award and judgment dated 01.02.2025 [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"] passed by the learned District Judge and Additional Sessions Judge, PO MACT (SE), Saket Courts, New Delhi.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, PO MACT (SE), Saket Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By the Impugned Award, compensation in the sum of Rs.46,69,500/-
has been awarded along with interest at the rate of 9% per annum.
4. Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that the ground for challenge in the present Appeal is that firstly, 50% was granted towards

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 29/06/2025 at 18:30:21 future prospects instead of 40%.
It is stated that the Appellant was not a permanent employee and was under the age of 40 years, thus the future prospects should have been considered at 40%.
4.1 Secondly, it is submitted that conveyance charges of Rs. 3,300/- which were not part of the income, were taken as part of the income.
4.2. Thirdly, it is contended that the interest awarded at the rate of 9% per annum is excessive.

5. So far as concerns the awarded interest at the rate of 9% per annum, given the fact that the interest awarded is not excessive, this Court does not deem it apposite to issue Notice qua this aspect of the matter.

sentences.text: 6. Issue Notice, limited to the first and second ground that are raised by the Appellant.

An affidavit of service be filed within a week.

6.1 Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that the service of Respondent Nos.4 and 5 may be dispensed with since there existed a valid contract of insurance and there was no violation of the same.
7. Subject to the deposit of entire decretal amount inclusive of up-to-date interest within a period of 6 weeks, the operation of the Impugned Award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
In the event, there is any default in depositing the amount, the interim protection granted by this Court shall automatically stand vacated.

8. Upon deposit by the Appellant, 60% of the deposited amount inclusive of up to date interest shall be released to the Respondent Nos.1 to 3/claimants in accordance with scheme, as is set out in the Impugned Award.
